title: Cipher and Asset
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Mara Vasquez, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
